items.title: Wilbert Tillman Interview, 1961-08-15
items.q: They called one of them Dude, Dude was the trumpet player and Forstown was the trombone player.

ctx.x: I asked you about the Lewis, the Lewis's, you said there were brothers, there was Foster Lewis and there was Dude Lewis?

Yeah. What was the Dude's name? Well, I'll tell you the truth, I know that wasn't the right name but it was the only name known by the musicians. They called one of them Dude, Dude was the trumpet player and Forstown was the trombone player.
